test_title: PYST 42: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Posthumusly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word 'posthumusly' is 'posthumously'.
 
• The meaning of the word 'posthumously' is 'after the death of the originator'.
 
 
• Example: A number of songs were posthumously published in 1924"
 
 
 
• Hence, the incorrectly spelt word is 'posthumusly'.
 
• Thus option 3 is the correct answer.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see meaning of other words given in the option-

 
 
• ​Cushion- A bag of cloth stuffed with a mass of soft material, used as a comfortable support for sitting or leaning on.
 
• Scientist- A person who is studying or has expert knowledge of one or more of the natural or physical sciences.
 
• Laboratory- A room or building equipped for scientific experiments, research, or teaching, or for the manufacture of drugs or chemicals.
